---
title: "Layered marks: points and a smooth"
description: "Two marks over the same data — a scatter and a linear smooth with a confidence band."
categories: [Basics]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

Marks stack in the order you pipe them. Here a `mark_point()` layer is drawn
first, then a `mark_smooth()` fits a linear model and draws its confidence band
on top.

```{r}
peng <- na.omit(datasets::penguins)

p <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_point(x = bill_len, y = body_mass, color = species, alpha = 0.5) |>
  mark_smooth(x = bill_len, y = body_mass, method = "lm", se = TRUE) |>
  labs(title = "Linear smooth with confidence band",
       x = "bill length (mm)", y = "body mass (g)")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "layered-smooth")
```
